title: Cosmic Otter Portal
description: A vibrant, multicolored otter with glowing purple eyes sits atop a swirling circular portal that contains a smaller otter. The portal spills a waterfall of smaller otter images and symbols downward into a crystalline pool below. The background is a swirling cosmic nebula filled with floating crystals and social media icons.
prompt: A luminous multicolored otter with bright purple eyes sits curled atop a large circular swirling portal containing a smaller otter at its center. The portal flows like a waterfall made of smaller otter icons and symbols cascading into a crystalline splash below. The scene is set in a vibrant cosmic nebula with floating crystals and glowing social media icons in the background, highly detailed psychedelic fantasy digital art.
